// Get the old folder, and clear the special folder flag on it, but only if no
  // other identity is using it.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fixed URI setter calls setFolderPref. It clears the old folder flag only when no other identity still uses that URI, sets the new existing folder flag, and clears the temporary return-receipt filter for Sent. testOldFolderFlagIsReset directly checks that a shared Drafts flag remains until the last identity leaves. The original refactor removed setter side effects, but that historical intent is not the current contract. The IDL summary that URI attributes just get or set preferences is incomplete for these side effects. No test or account migration ran.
title: Changing an identity folder URI still updates shared special-folder flags
